description: The team is planning a weekend trip together.

calibrationQuestions.text: What time does the team arrive at Heathrow airport in London?
What is the name of the hotel they are staying at?
How is the team getting from the airport to the hotel?
What time will we all meet in the hotel lobby on Day 2?
What activities are you planning on Day 2?

voiceSamplePassage: I am recording this sample so Echo can represent my voice during our weekend trip planning meeting. We will discuss destinations, travel dates, hotels, and activities for Day 1 and Day 2. I will speak clearly and at a natural pace.
